item.title: Emporer Caladwen
item.description:
Emporer Caladwen is the emporer Squawhorn, who sits the throne of The Twilight Court. He is the father to Aelrya Caladwen.

The Emporer is a greedy authoritarian, embezzling from or overtaxing commoners and running a fascist regime. When his daughter began publicly speaking out against him, he attempted to silence her and to force her obedience. When she disappeared, he became beset on bringing her home and molding her into the future Empress of the Twilight Court that she was born to be, whether she likes it or not.

item.title: General Ashryver
item.description:
General Ashryver was once the top general of Squawhorn, who would regularly counsil with The Twilight Court and served as its military arm. He is the late father to Syren Ashryver.

He dead bruh.

item.title: Thaddeus Miller
item.description:
Thaddeus Miller (known as Thad) is the father of Vesper Dreadway. Described by many as a good man, Vesper would call him “the sweetest human you’ve ever met,” and a man at market in Norville called him “salt of the earth.” He gave Vesper her first dagger.

He is alive and well, still living in Ratwhistle.

item.title: Vesper and Syren's mother
item.description:
This is the Elven mother of Syren and Vesper.

All we know of her is that she birthed Syren, but abandoned her early in Syren’s life, running off somewhere. She ended up in Ratwhistle, fell in love with Thad, and gave birth to Vesper. She died during childbirth.

item.title: Findlay
item.description: Findlay is the owner of the Lamp Emporium in Norville. He had enslaved the demon Belvedere as his personal servent as well as several Imps as his workers, until he accidentally destroyed his demonic contracts in Session #1, freeing the demon and imps from their bonds. The players freed the imps and implored Findlay to hire paid workers in the future instead of meddling with the enslavement of demons and imps.
